name: Faol's Rest
summary: In eastern Tirisfal, Faol's Rest lies neglected southwest of the Scarlet Monastery. The gravesite holds the tomb of Archbishop Alonsus Faol, founder of the Knights of the Silver Hand. Beneath the blighted canopy, it is now a resting place for spirits who perish near the monastery.

sections.title: Tomb of the Archbishop
sections.body: Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, mourners traveled to Faol's Rest to honor Archbishop Alonsus Faol. He led the Church of the Holy Light through the dark days of the Second War and founded the paladins to protect humanity. Faol died peacefully before the Scourge arrived, spared the agony of seeing his kingdom fall. In those years, mourners journeyed up the road from Capital City to leave offerings and pay their respects to the beloved patriarch.

sections.title: Desolation in the Shadow of the Monastery
sections.body: The Plague of Undeath withered Tirisfal, and the pilgrims stopped coming. Now the monument lies abandoned and cracked beneath the Scarlet Monastery's high bluffs. Wild brush has reclaimed the pathways, and the tomb rests amid damp mist. Those who fall near the monastery or elsewhere in Tirisfal find a quiet place here to gather their spirits before returning to the dangers around them.

faq.answer: Alonsus Faol led the Church of the Holy Light as Archbishop during the Second War. Revered for his wisdom and compassion, he organized relief for refugees and founded the Knights of the Silver Hand. He united holy priests and pious knights as humanity's first paladins, including Uther the Lightbringer and Turalyon.

faq.q: Why is this monument located near the Scarlet Monastery?
faq.answer: The Church of the Holy Light held religious grounds near the Scarlet Monastery in northern Lordaeron. Faol was laid to rest in this tranquil corner of Tirisfal Glades before the kingdom fell, long before scarlet-clad zealots fortified the nearby monastery.

faq.q: Is anyone maintaining the tomb today?
faq.answer: No one tends the tomb. Since the Scourge took Lordaeron, the site has been neglected. The Scarlet Crusade rarely descends into the hollow to care for it, and the Forsaken have little interest in honoring the old church's shrines, leaving the stone markers weathered and overgrown.

faq.q: What practical purpose does Faol's Rest serve for travelers?
aliases: what is this place in game
faq.answer: Faol's Rest is the local spirit graveyard for the surrounding wilderness and the Scarlet Monastery. Those who perish trying to enter the monastery or traveling through eastern Tirisfal find their spirits returning to the Archbishop's quiet monument.

angles.text: As a paladin, your calling traces back to Archbishop Faol, who first gathered Uther and his peers to unite martial skill with the Holy Light. His untended tomb recalls the order's beginnings.
As a priest, you follow the faith Faol led as the Church of the Holy Light's supreme leader through the Second War. His ruined monument reflects the church's tragic ruin in northern Lordaeron.
